verses.text: Welcome those whose faith is weak, but don't get into arguments over disputed opinions.
One person believes they can eat anything, while another, whose faith is weak, eats only vegetables.
The one who eats must not look down on the one who doesn't, and the one who doesn't eat must not judge the one who does. God has welcomed them.
Who are you to judge someone else's servant? Their own master decides whether they stand or fall. And they will stand, because the Lord is able to make them stand.
One person considers one day more special than another; someone else considers every day alike. Each should be fully convinced in their own mind.
Whoever observes a special day does so for the Lord. Whoever eats does so for the Lord, since they give thanks to God; whoever abstains does so for the Lord and gives thanks to God.
None of us lives for ourselves alone, and none of us dies for ourselves alone.
If we live, we live for the Lord; if we die, we die for the Lord. So whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.
This is why Christ died, came back to life, and lives again: to be Lord of both the dead and the living.
So why do you judge your brother or sister? And why do you look down on them? We will all stand before God's judgment seat.
For Scripture says, ‘As surely as I live, says the Lord, every knee will bow to me, and every tongue will praise God.’
So each of us will give an account of ourselves to God.
Let's stop judging one another. Instead, decide not to put an obstacle or trap in the way of a brother or sister.
I know, and am convinced in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean by itself. But if someone considers something unclean, then for that person it is unclean.
If your brother or sister is hurt because of what you eat, you're no longer acting in love. Don't destroy someone Christ died for just because of your food.
So don't let what you consider good be spoken of as evil.
God's Kingdom isn't about food and drink. It's about righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
Anyone who serves Christ this way is pleasing to God and respected by people.
So let's pursue what makes for peace and builds one another up.
Don't tear down God's work for the sake of food. Everything is clean, but it's wrong to eat in a way that trips someone up.
It's good not to eat meat, drink wine, or do anything that causes your brother or sister to stumble.
Whatever you believe about these things, keep it between yourself and God. Blessed is the person who doesn't condemn themselves by doing what they believe is right.
But whoever has doubts is condemned if they eat, because they aren't acting from faith. Anything that doesn't come from faith is sin.
Now to the one who can strengthen you according to my Good News and the message about Jesus Christ—the revelation of the mystery kept secret for long ages,
but now revealed and made known through the prophetic Scriptures, by the command of the eternal God, so that all nations may come to the obedience of faith—
to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, be glory forever! Amen.
